unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 9 - Speak Up - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. Say it. The writing anchor plus a microphone (say it), and the speech rule: write for the ear. Final piece: a rehearsed persuasive speech delivered to a live audience.

lessons.title: Rehearse and Refine
lessons.focus: Edit by ear, rehearse in trios with feedback, and make final changes. Critical feature: practise the hard parts, not the whole thing again.

lessons.title: Speech Day
lessons.focus: Deliver the persuasive speech to a live audience and reflect. Critical feature: the audience should know what you want them to do.
